                function Slider:Set(Value)
                    Slider.Value = Library:Round(math.clamp(Value, Slider.Min, Slider.Max), Slider.Decimals)

                    Items["Accent"]:Tween({Size = UDim2.new((Slider.Value - Slider.Min) / (Slider.Max - Slider.Min), 0, 1, 0)}, TweenInfo.new(Library.Animation.Time, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out))
                    Items["Value"].Instance.Text = string.format("%s%s", Slider.Value, Slider.Suffix)

                    Flags[Slider.Flag] = Slider.Value
                    Library:SafeCall(Slider.Callback, Slider.Value)
                end

                function Slider:SetVisibility(Bool)
                    Items["Slider"].Instance.Visible = Bool
                end

                function Slider:GetSize(Input)
                    local SizeX = (Input.Position.X - Items["RealSlider"].Instance.AbsolutePosition.X) / Items["RealSlider"].Instance.AbsoluteSize.X
                    local Value = ((Slider.Max - Slider.Min) * SizeX) + Slider.Min

                    return Value
                end

                function Slider:SetText(Text)
                    Items["Text"].Instance.Text = tostring(Text)
                end

                local InputChanged

                Items["RealSlider"]:Connect("InputBegan", function(Input)
                    if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        Slider.Sliding = true

                        local Value = Slider:GetSize(Input)

                        Slider:Set(Value)

                        if InputChanged then
                            return
                        end

                        InputChanged = Library:Connect(Input.Changed, function()
                            if Input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                                Slider.Sliding = false

                                InputChanged:Disconnect()
                                InputChanged = nil
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end)

                Library:Connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(Input)
                    if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        if Slider.Sliding then
                            local Value = Slider:GetSize(Input)

                            Slider:Set(Value)
                        end
                    end
                end)

                Slider:Set(Slider.Default)

                Library.Controls[Slider.Flag] = Slider
                SetFlags[Slider.Flag] = function(Value)
                    Slider:Set(Value)
                end

                return setmetatable(Slider, Library)
            end

            Library.Dropdown = function(Self, Params)
                Params = Params or { }
                Params.Scrollable = true

                local Dropdown = {
                    Name = Params.Name or Params.name or "Dropdown",
                    OptionItems = Params.Items or Params.items or { },
                    Flag = Params.Flag or Params.flag or (Params.Name or Params.name),
                    Default = Params.Default or Params.default or "",
                    Callback = Params.Callback or Params.callback or function() end,
                    Multi = Params.Multi or Params.multi or false,

                    Window = Self.Window,
                    Page = Self.Page,
                    Section = Self,

                    Value = { },
                    Options = { },
                    IsOpen = false,
                    Items = { }
                }

                local Parent

                if Params.Parent then
                    Parent = Params.Parent
                else
                    Parent = Dropdown.Section.Items["Content"]
                end

                local Items = { } do
                    Items["Dropdown"] = Library:Create("Frame", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        Parent = Parent.Instance,
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35),
                        BorderSizePixel = 0
                    })

                    Items["Text"] = Library:Create("TextLabel", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        FontFace = Library.Font,
                        TextSize = Library.FontSize,
                        Parent = Items["Dropdown"].Instance,
                        TextColor3 = Library.Theme["Text"],
                        Text = Dropdown.Name,
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 12),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 0),
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
                    }):AddToTheme({TextColor3 = 'Text'})

                    Library:Create("UIStroke", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        Parent = Items["Text"].Instance
                    })

                    Items["RealDropdown"] = Library:Create("TextButton", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        FontFace = Library.Font,
                        TextSize = Library.FontSize,
                        Parent = Items["Dropdown"].Instance,
                        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
                        Text = "",
                        AutoButtonColor = false,
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, 0),
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 18),
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        BackgroundColor3 = Library.Theme["Inline"]
                    }):AddToTheme({BackgroundColor3 = 'Inline'})

                    Library:Create("UIStroke", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        Parent = Items["RealDropdown"].Instance,
                        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
                        LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter,
                        Color = Library.Theme["Outline 1"]
                    }):AddToTheme({Color = 'Outline 1'})

                    Library:Create("UIStroke", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        Parent = Items["RealDropdown"].Instance,
                        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
                        LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter,
                        Color = Library.Theme["Outline 3"],
                        BorderOffset = UDim.new(0, 1)
                    }):AddToTheme({Color = 'Outline 3'})

                    Items["Value"] = Library:Create("TextLabel", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        FontFace = Library.Font,
                        TextSize = Library.FontSize,
                        Parent = Items["RealDropdown"].Instance,
                        TextColor3 = Library.Theme["Inactive Text"],
                        Text = "...",
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 12),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.5, 0),
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
                    }):AddToTheme({TextColor3 = 'Inactive Text'})

                    Library:Create("UIStroke", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        Parent = Items["Value"].Instance
                    })

                    Items["OptionHolder"] = Library:Create("TextButton", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        FontFace = Library.Font,
                        TextSize = Library.FontSize,
                        Parent = Library.UnusedHolder.Instance,
                        Visible = false,
                        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
                        Text = "",
                        AutoButtonColor = false,
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, 246, 0, 0),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, 979, 0, 167),
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                        BackgroundColor3 = Library.Theme["Background"]
                    }):AddToTheme({BackgroundColor3 = 'Background'})

                    Library:Create("UIStroke", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        Parent = Items["OptionHolder"].Instance,
                        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
                        LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter,
                        Color = Library.Theme["Outline 3"],
                        BorderOffset = UDim.new(0, 1)
                    }):AddToTheme({Color = 'Outline 3'})

                    Library:Create("UIStroke", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        Parent = Items["OptionHolder"].Instance,
                        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
                        LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter,
                        Color = Library.Theme["Outline 1"]
                    }):AddToTheme({Color = 'Outline 1'})

                    Items["OptionContent"] = Items["OptionHolder"]
                    if Params.Scrollable then
                        Items["OptionHolder"].Instance.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
                        Items["OptionContent"] = Library:Create("ScrollingFrame", {
                            Name = "Options",
                            Parent = Items["OptionHolder"].Instance,
                            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                            BorderSizePixel = 0,
                            Active = true,
                            ClipsDescendants = true,
                            ScrollingEnabled = true,
                            ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
                            AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                            CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
                            ScrollBarThickness = 5,
                            ScrollBarImageColor3 = Library.Theme.Accent,
                        }):AddToTheme({ScrollBarImageColor3 = "Accent"})
                    end

                    Library:Create("UIPadding", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        Parent = Items["OptionContent"].Instance,
                        PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6),
                        PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6),
                        PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, Params.Scrollable and 12 or 6),
                        PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6)
                    })

                    Library:Create("UIListLayout", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        Parent = Items["OptionContent"].Instance,
                        Padding = UDim.new(0, 5),
                        SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
                    })

                    Items["RealDropdown"]:OnHover(function()
                        Items["RealDropdown"]:Tween({BackgroundColor3 = Library.Theme["Hovered Element"]})
                    end, function()
                        Items["RealDropdown"]:Tween({BackgroundColor3 = Library.Theme["Content"]})
                    end)

                    Dropdown.Items = Items
                end

                Dropdown.Holder = Items["OptionHolder"]

                function Dropdown:Set(Value)
                    if Dropdown.Multi then
                        if type(Value) ~= "table" then
                            return
                        end

                        Dropdown.Value = table.clone(Value)

                        for Name, OptionData in Dropdown.Options do
                            OptionData.IsSelected = table.find(Value, Name) ~= nil
                            OptionData:ToggleState(OptionData.IsSelected and "Active" or "Inactive")
                        end

                        Flags[Dropdown.Flag] = Dropdown.Value
                        Items["Value"].Instance.Text = table.concat(Dropdown.Value, ", ")
                    else
                        if not Dropdown.Options[Value] then
                            return
                        end

                        local OptionData = Dropdown.Options[Value]

                        Dropdown.Value = Value

                        for Index, Value in Dropdown.Options do
                            if Value ~= OptionData then
                                Value.IsSelected = false
                                Value:ToggleState("Inactive")
                            else
                                Value.IsSelected = true
                                Value:ToggleState("Active")
                            end
                        end

                        Flags[Dropdown.Flag] = Value
                        Items["Value"].Instance.Text = Value
                    end

                    Library:SafeCall(Dropdown.Callback, Dropdown.Value)
                end

                function Dropdown:Add(Value)
                    local OptionButton = Library:Create("TextButton", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        FontFace = Library.Font,
                        TextSize = Library.FontSize,
                        Parent = Items["OptionContent"].Instance,
                        TextColor3 = Library.Theme["Inactive Text"],
                        Text = Value,
                        AutoButtonColor = false,
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12),
                        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
                    }):AddToTheme({TextColor3 = 'Inactive Text'})

                    Library:Create("UIStroke", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        Parent = OptionButton.Instance
                    })

                    local OptionData = {
                        Button = OptionButton,
                        Text = OptionButton,
                        Name = Value,
                        IsSelected = false
                    }

                    OptionButton:OnHover(function()
                        if OptionData.IsSelected then return end
                        OptionButton:Tween({TextColor3 = Library.Theme.Text})
                    end, function()
                        if OptionData.IsSelected then return end
                        OptionButton:Tween({TextColor3 = Library.Theme["Inactive Text"]})
                    end)

                    function OptionData:ToggleState(Value)
                        if Value == "Active" then
                            OptionData.Text:ChangeItemTheme({TextColor3 = "Accent"})
                            OptionData.Text:Tween({TextColor3 = Library.Theme.Accent})
                        else
                            OptionData.Text:ChangeItemTheme({TextColor3 = "Inactive Text"})
                            OptionData.Text:Tween({TextColor3 = Library.Theme["Inactive Text"]})
                        end
                    end

                    function OptionData:Set()
                        if not Dropdown.Multi and Params.AllowEmpty == false and OptionData.IsSelected then return end
                        OptionData.IsSelected = not OptionData.IsSelected

                        if Dropdown.Multi then
                            local Index = table.find(Dropdown.Value, OptionData.Name)

                            if Index then
                                table.remove(Dropdown.Value, Index)
                            else
                                table.insert(Dropdown.Value, OptionData.Name)
                            end

                            OptionData:ToggleState(Index and "Inactive" or "Active")

                            Flags[Dropdown.Flag] = Dropdown.Value

                            local TextFormat = #Dropdown.Value > 0 and table.concat(Dropdown.Value, ", ") or "..."
                            Items["Value"].Instance.Text = TextFormat
                        else
                            if OptionData.IsSelected then
                                Dropdown.Value = OptionData.Name
                                Flags[Dropdown.Flag] = OptionData.Name

                                OptionData.IsSelected = true
                                OptionData:ToggleState("Active")

                                for Index, Value in Dropdown.Options do
                                    if Value ~= OptionData then
                                        Value.IsSelected = false
                                        Value:ToggleState("Inactive")
                                    end
                                end

                                Items["Value"].Instance.Text = OptionData.Name
                            else
                                Dropdown.Value = nil
                                Flags[Dropdown.Flag] = nil

                                OptionData.IsSelected = false
                                OptionData:ToggleState("Inactive")

                                Items["Value"].Instance.Text = "..."
                            end
                        end

                        Library:SafeCall(Dropdown.Callback, Dropdown.Value)
                    end

                    OptionData.Button:Connect("Activated", function()
                        OptionData:Set()
                    end)

                    Dropdown.Options[OptionData.Name] = OptionData
                    return OptionData
                end

                function Dropdown:Remove(Option)
                    if Dropdown.Options[Option] then
                        Dropdown.Options[Option].Button.Instance:Destroy()
                        Dropdown.Options[Option] = nil
                    end
                end

                function Dropdown:Refresh(List)
                    for Index, Value in Dropdown.Options do
                        Dropdown:Remove(Value.Name)
                    end

                    for Index, Value in List do
                        Dropdown:Add(Value)
                    end

                    if Dropdown.Multi then
                        local Selected = { }
                        for _, Value in Dropdown.Value do
                            if Dropdown.Options[Value] then
                                table.insert(Selected, Value)
                            end
                        end
                        Dropdown:Set(Selected)
                    elseif Dropdown.Options[Dropdown.Value] then
                        Dropdown:Set(Dropdown.Value)
                    else
                        Dropdown.Value = nil
                        Flags[Dropdown.Flag] = nil
                        Items["Value"].Instance.Text = "None"
                    end
                end

                function Dropdown:SetText(Text)
                    Items["Text"].Instance.Text = tostring(Text)
                end

                function Dropdown:SetVisibility(Bool)
                    Items["Dropdown"].Instance.Visible = Bool
                end

                local Debounce = false
                local OptionHolder = Items["OptionHolder"].Instance
                local RealDropdown = Items["RealDropdown"].Instance

                local IsSettings = Dropdown.Section and Dropdown.Section.IsSettings

                function Dropdown:SetOpen(Bool)
                    if Debounce then
                        return
                    end

                    Dropdown.IsOpen = Bool

                    Debounce = true

                    if Dropdown.IsOpen then
                        OptionHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0, RealDropdown.AbsolutePosition.X, 0, RealDropdown.AbsolutePosition.Y + RealDropdown.AbsoluteSize.Y + GuiInset)
                        OptionHolder.Size = UDim2.new(0, RealDropdown.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 0)

                        OptionHolder.Parent = Library.Holder.Instance
                        Items["OptionHolder"]:Tween({Position = UDim2.new(0, RealDropdown.AbsolutePosition.X, 0, RealDropdown.AbsolutePosition.Y + RealDropdown.AbsoluteSize.Y + 10 + GuiInset)})

                        if Params.Scrollable then
                            local Bounds = Library.Holder.Instance.AbsoluteSize
                            local Below = RealDropdown.AbsolutePosition.Y + RealDropdown.AbsoluteSize.Y + GuiInset + 10
                            local Above = RealDropdown.AbsolutePosition.Y + GuiInset - 10
                            local UseAbove = Bounds.Y - Below - 8 < math.min(240, Above - 8)
                            local Available = UseAbove and Above - 8 or Bounds.Y - Below - 8
                            local Count = 0
                            for _ in Dropdown.Options do
                                Count += 1
                            end
                            local Height = math.max(24, math.min(240, Available, Count * 17 + 7))
                            local Y = UseAbove and Above - Height or Below
                            Items["OptionHolder"]:Tween({Position = UDim2.fromOffset(RealDropdown.AbsolutePosition.X, math.max(8, Y))})
                            OptionHolder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(RealDropdown.AbsoluteSize.X, Height)
                        end

                        Items["OptionHolder"]:FadeDescendants(true, function()
                            Debounce = false
                        end)

                        for Index, Value in Library.OpenFrames do
                            if Value ~= IsSettings and not Params.Parent then
                                Value:SetOpen(false)
                            end
                        end

                        Library.OpenFrames[Dropdown] = Dropdown
                    else
                        Items["OptionHolder"]:Tween({Position = UDim2.new(0, RealDropdown.AbsolutePosition.X, 0, RealDropdown.AbsolutePosition.Y + RealDropdown.AbsoluteSize.Y - 10 + GuiInset)})
                        Items["OptionHolder"]:FadeDescendants(false, function()
                            OptionHolder.Parent = Library.UnusedHolder.Instance
                            Debounce = false
                        end)

                        if Library.OpenFrames[Dropdown] then
                            Library.OpenFrames[Dropdown] = nil
                        end
                    end

                    local Descendants = OptionHolder:GetDescendants()
                    table.insert(Descendants, OptionHolder)

                    for Index, Value in Descendants do
                        if not Value.ClassName:find("UI") then
                            if not Params.Parent then
                                Value.ZIndex = Dropdown.IsOpen and Library.ZIndexOrder.OptionHolder or 1
                            else
                                Value.ZIndex = Dropdown.IsOpen and Library.ZIndexOrder.OptionHolder + 3 or 1
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                Items["RealDropdown"]:Connect("MouseButton1Down", function()
                    Dropdown:SetOpen(not Dropdown.IsOpen)
                end)

                Library:Connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(Input)
                    if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                        if not Dropdown.IsOpen then
                            return
                        end

                        if Items["OptionHolder"]:IsMouseOverFrame() then
                            return
                        end

                        Dropdown:SetOpen(false)
                    end
                end)

                for Index, Value in Dropdown.OptionItems do
                    Dropdown:Add(Value)
                end

                Dropdown:Set(Dropdown.Default)

                Library.Controls[Dropdown.Flag] = Dropdown
                SetFlags[Dropdown.Flag] = function(Value)
                    Dropdown:Set(Value)
                end

                return setmetatable(Dropdown, Library)
            end

            Library.Textbox = function(Self, Params)
                Params = Params or { }

                local Textbox = {
                    Name = Params.Name or Params.name or "Textbox",
                    Flag = Params.Flag or Params.flag or (Params.Name or Params.name),
                    Default = Params.Default or Params.default or "",
                    Callback = Params.Callback or Params.callback or function() end,
                    Finished = Params.Finished or Params.finished or false,
                    Placeholder = Params.Placeholder or Params.placeholder or "",
                    Numeric = Params.Numeric or Params.numeric or false,

                    Window = Self.Window,
                    Page = Self.Page,
                    Section = Self,
                    Value = "",

                    Items = { },
                }

                local Parent

                if Params.Parent then
                    Parent = Params.Parent
                else
                    Parent = Textbox.Section.Items["Content"]
                end

                local Items = { } do
                    Items["Textbox"] = Library:Create("Frame", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        Parent = Parent.Instance,
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, IsMobile and 36 or 20),
                        BorderSizePixel = 0
                    })

                    Items["Background"] = Library:Create("Frame", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        Parent = Items["Textbox"].Instance,
                        ClipsDescendants = true,
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, IsMobile and 34 or 18),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, 0),
                        Selectable = true,
                        Active = true,
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        BackgroundColor3 = Library.Theme["Inline"]
                    }):AddToTheme({BackgroundColor3 = 'Inline'})

                    Library:Create("UIStroke", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        Parent = Items["Background"].Instance,
                        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
                        LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter,
                        Color = Library.Theme["Outline 1"]
                    }):AddToTheme({Color = 'Outline 1'})

                    Library:Create("UIStroke", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        Parent = Items["Background"].Instance,
                        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
                        LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter,
                        Color = Library.Theme["Outline 3"],
                        BorderOffset = UDim.new(0, 1)
                    }):AddToTheme({Color = 'Outline 3'})

                    Items["Input"] = Library:Create("TextBox", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        FontFace = Library.Font,
                        TextSize = Library.FontSize,
                        Parent = Items["Background"].Instance,
                        Active = true,
                        Selectable = true,
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
                        PlaceholderColor3 = Library.Theme["Inactive Text"],
                        PlaceholderText = Textbox.Placeholder,
                        Size = IsMobile and UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, 0) or UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 12),
                        TextColor3 = Library.Theme["Text"],
                        Text = "",
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.5, 0),
                        CursorPosition = -1,
                        ClearTextOnFocus = false,
                        BorderSizePixel = 0
                    }):AddToTheme({TextColor3 = 'Text', PlaceholderColor3 = 'Inactive Text'})

                    Library:Create("UIStroke", {
                        Name = "\0",
                        Parent = Items["Input"].Instance
                    })

                    Textbox.Items = Items
                end

                function Textbox:SetVisibility(Bool)
                    Items["Textbox"].Instance.Visible = Bool
                end

                function Textbox:SetText(Text)
                    Items["Text"].Instance.Text = tostring(Text)
                end

                function Textbox:Set(Value)
                    if Textbox.Updating then
                        return
                    end

                    Value = tostring(Value or "")
                    if Textbox.Numeric then
                        if (not tonumber(Value)) and string.len(tostring(Value)) > 0 then
                            Value = Textbox.Value
                        end
                    end

                    Textbox.Value = Value
                    Textbox.Updating = true
                    if Items["Input"].Instance.Text ~= Value then
                        Items["Input"].Instance.Text = Value
                    end
                    Textbox.Updating = false
                    Flags[Textbox.Flag] = Value

                    Library:SafeCall(Textbox.Callback, Value)
                end

                if Textbox.Finished then
                    Items["Input"]:Connect("FocusLost", function(PressedEnterQuestionMark)
                        Textbox:Set(Items["Input"].Instance.Text)
                    end)
                else
                    Library:Connect(Items["Input"].Instance:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
                        Textbox:Set(Items["Input"].Instance.Text)
                    end)

															local str8 = "ElisiumV2/Assets/ValorantArms/" .. arg2.File
															local v89 = isfile(str8) and readfile(str8)

															local tbl57 = {}
															local tbl58 = {}
															local tbl59 = {}

															local function fn34(arg3, arg4)
																local num = tonumber(arg3)
																if not num then
																	return nil
																end

																if num < 0 then
																	num = arg4 + num + v83[184]
																end

																assert(num >= 1 and num <= arg4 and num % 1 == 0, "invalid OBJ index")
																return num
															end

															local n = 0

															for match in v89:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
																n += 1

																if n % 512 == v83[140] then
																	task.wait()
																	assert(not arg.Unloaded, "mesh load cancelled")
																end

																local match2, v90 = match:match("^%s*(%S+)%s+(.+)$")

																if match2 == "v" or match2 == "vn" or match2 == "vt" then
																	local match3, v91, v92 = v90:match("^(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s*(%S*)")
																	local num = tonumber(match3)
																	local num2 = tonumber(v91)
																	local num3 = tonumber(v92)
																	assert(num and num2 and (match2 == "vt" or num3), "invalid OBJ coordinate")

																	if match2 == "v" then
																		tbl57[#tbl57 + v83[184]] = Vector3.new(num, num2, num3)
																	elseif match2 == "vn" then
																		tbl59[#tbl59 + 1] = Vector3.new(num, num2, num3)
																	else
																		tbl58[#tbl58 + v83[184]] = Vector2.new(num, 1 - num2)
																	end
																elseif match2 == "f" then
																	local tbl61 = {}

																	for match3 in v90:gmatch("%S+") do
																		if match3:sub(1, 1) ~= "#" then
																			local match4, v91, v92 = match3:match("^(%-?%d+)/?(%-?%d*)/?(%-?%d*)$")
																			assert(match4, "invalid OBJ face")
																			local n35 = #tbl61 + v83[184]
																			local tbl62 = {}
																			local v93 = fn34(match4, #tbl57)
																			local v94 = fn34(v91, #tbl58)
																			local v95 = fn34(v92, #tbl59)
																			tbl62[1] = v93
																			tbl62[2] = v94
																			tbl62[3] = v95
																			tbl61[n35] = tbl62
																			continue
																		end

																		break
																	end

																	assert(#tbl61 == 3 or #tbl61 == 4, "OBJ faces must be triangles or quads")
																	tbl60[#tbl60 + 1] = { tbl61[v83[184]], tbl61[2], tbl61[3] }

																	if #tbl61 == 4 then
																		tbl60[#tbl60 + 1] = { tbl61[1], tbl61[3], tbl61[4] }
																	end
																end
															end

															assert(#tbl57 > 0 and #tbl60 > 0, "empty OBJ")
															assert(#tbl57 <= 60000 and #tbl60 <= 20000, "OBJ exceeds Roblox's 60000 vertex / 20000 triangle limit")
															local v90 = tbl57[1]
															local v91 = tbl57[1]

															for _, v92 in tbl57, nil, nil do
																v90 = v90:Min(v92)
																v91 = v91:Max(v92)
															end

															local n35 = (v90 + v91) * 0.5
															local v92 = game:GetService("AssetService"):CreateEditableMesh()
															assert(v92, "editable mesh memory budget unavailable")
															local v93 = nil

															local ok, result = pcall(function()
																local tbl61 = {}
																local tbl62 = {}
																local tbl63 = {}

																for k, v94 in tbl57, nil, nil do
																	tbl61[k] = v92:AddVertex(v94 - n35)

																	if k % 512 == 0 then
																		task.wait()
																		assert(not arg.Unloaded, "mesh load cancelled")
																	end
																end

																for k, v94 in tbl58, nil, nil do
																	tbl62[k] = v92:AddUV(v94)
																end

																for k, v94 in tbl59, nil, nil do
																	tbl63[k] = v92:AddNormal(v94)
																end

																for k, v94 in tbl60, nil, nil do
																	local v95 = v94[1]
																	local v96 = v94[2]
																	local v97 = v94[v83[72]]
																	local v98 = v92:AddTriangle(tbl61[v95[1]], tbl61[v96[1]], tbl61[v97[1]])

																	if v95[2] and v96[2] and v97[v83[110]] then
																		v92:SetFaceUVs(v98, { tbl62[v95[2]], tbl62[v96[2]], tbl62[v97[v83[110]]] })
																	end

																	if v95[v83[72]] and v96[3] and v97[3] then
																		v92:SetFaceNormals(v98, { tbl63[v95[3]], tbl63[v96[v83[72]]], tbl63[v97[3]] })
																	end

																	if k % 512 == v83[140] then
																		task.wait()
																		assert(not arg.Unloaded, "mesh load cancelled")
																	end
																end

																local tbl64 = { CollisionFidelity = Enum.CollisionFidelity.Box }
																v93 = game:GetService("AssetService"):CreateMeshPartAsync(Content.fromObject(v92), tbl64)
																assert(not arg.Unloaded, "mesh load cancelled")
															end)

															if not ok then
																if v93 then
																	v93:Destroy()
																end

																v92:Destroy()
																error(result, 0)
															end

															return { Template = v93, Editable = v92, Center = n35, Size = v91 - v90 }
														end

										tbl51.GetFrame = function(arg)

											if magnitude ~= magnitude then
												magnitude = math.huge
											end

											local client = desync and desync.rootPart == arg.Root and desync:GetClient()
											local magnitude2

											if client then
												magnitude2 = currentCamera2 and (client.Position - currentCamera2).Magnitude or 0

												if not (magnitude2 < magnitude) then
													magnitude2 = magnitude
													client = cFrame
												end
											else

												client = cFrame
											end

											local v89

											if clientCframe then

													v89 = client

												end

												v89 = client
											end

											return v89
										end

										tbl51.Update = function(arg, arg2)
											local gamingChair = getgenv().Elisium.Character.GamingChair
											if arg.Unloaded or not gamingChair.Enabled then
												arg:Refresh()
												return
											end
											local character = localPlayer.Character
											local now2 = os.clock()

											if character ~= arg.Character then
												arg:Clear()
												arg.Character = character
											end

											if not character or not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace_) then
												if arg.Model then
													arg:Clear()
												end

												return
											end

											if arg.Root and (not arg.Root:IsDescendantOf(character) or not arg.Humanoid:IsDescendantOf(character) or arg.Humanoid.Health <= v83[140]) then
												arg:Clear()
												arg.Character = character
												arg.NextResolve = now2 + 0.2
											end

											if not arg.Root then
												if now2 < arg.NextResolve then
													return
												end
												arg.NextResolve = now2 + 0.2
												local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
												local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
												if not humanoidRootPart or not humanoidRootPart:IsA("BasePart") or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
													return
												end
												arg.Root = humanoidRootPart
												arg.Humanoid = humanoid
												arg:Create()
											end

											if arg.VisualDestroyed or not arg.Model or arg.AppliedMeshRevision ~= arg.MeshRevision or arg.Seat.Parent ~= arg.Model or arg.Arms.Parent ~= arg.Model or arg.Legs.Parent ~= arg.Model or arg.Fan.Parent ~= arg.Model then
												arg:Create()
											end

											local scale = gamingChair.Scale
											local frame = arg:GetFrame()
											local cFrame = frame * CFrame.new(0, gamingChair.Height, 0) * cframe
											arg.Seat.CFrame = cFrame
											arg.Arms.CFrame = cFrame * CFrame.new(vector * scale)
											arg.Legs.CFrame = cFrame * CFrame.new(vector3 * scale)
											arg.FanAngle = (arg.FanAngle + arg2 * 3.1415926535897931 * gamingChair.FanSpeed) % 6.2831853071795862
											arg.Fan.CFrame = cFrame * CFrame.new(vector4 * scale) * CFrame.Angles(v83[140], arg.FanAngle, 3.1415926535897931)
											local currentCamera2 = workspace_.CurrentCamera or workspace_

											if arg.Model.Parent ~= currentCamera2 then
												arg.Model.Parent = currentCamera2
											end

											local smoothPlastic = tbl55[gamingChair.Material]

											if not smoothPlastic then
												gamingChair.Material = "SmoothPlastic"
												smoothPlastic = tbl55.SmoothPlastic
											end

											local flag18 = arg.AppliedScale ~= scale
											local enabled = getgenv().Elisium.Character.Fly.Enabled
											local flightAlpha = math.clamp(arg.FlightAlpha + arg2 / 0.3 * (enabled and gamingChair.Fan and v83[184] or -1), 0, 1)

											for _, v89 in arg.Parts, nil, nil do
												local part = v89.Part
												local flag19 = part == arg.Legs and flightAlpha >= 0.5
												local flag20

												if flag19 then
													flag20 = flag19
												else
													flag20 = part == arg.Fan and flightAlpha <= 0.5
												end

												local transparency = flag20 and 1 or gamingChair.Transparency

												if part.Color ~= gamingChair.BodyColor then
													part.Color = gamingChair.BodyColor
												end

												if part.Material ~= smoothPlastic then
													part.Material = smoothPlastic
												end

												if part.Transparency ~= transparency then
													part.Transparency = transparency
												end

												if part.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 0 then
													part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
												end

												if flag18 or flightAlpha ~= arg.FlightAlpha then
													local n36 = part == arg.Legs and (1 - math.min(flightAlpha * v83[110], 1)) ^ 2 or part == arg.Fan and math.max(flightAlpha * 2 - 1, 0) ^ 2 or 1
													part.Size = v89.Size * scale * (v89.Mesh and 1 or math.max(n36, 0.001))

													if v89.Mesh then
														v89.Mesh.Scale = v89.Scale * scale * n36
													end
												end
											end

											arg.Highlight.Enabled = gamingChair.Outline
											arg.Highlight.OutlineColor = gamingChair.Color
											arg.Highlight.OutlineTransparency = gamingChair.OutlineTransparency
											arg.Highlight.DepthMode = gamingChair.OutlineAbove and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
											arg.FlightAlpha = flightAlpha
											local enabled2 = gamingChair.Trails and not enabled

											if enabled2 then
												local running = Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running
												enabled2 = arg.Humanoid:GetState() == running
											end

											enabled2 = enabled2 and arg.Humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > v83[1]
											local assemblyLinearVelocity = arg.Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
											local trailFast = assemblyLinearVelocity.X * assemblyLinearVelocity.X + assemblyLinearVelocity.Z * assemblyLinearVelocity.Z > 576
											local position = frame.Position
											local flag19 = arg.TrailColor ~= gamingChair.TrailColor or arg.FastTrailColor ~= gamingChair.FastTrailColor

											if flag19 then
												local fastTrailColor = gamingChair.FastTrailColor
												arg.TrailColor = gamingChair.TrailColor
												arg.FastTrailColor = fastTrailColor
												local colorSequence = ColorSequence.new
												local fastTrailColor2 = arg.FastTrailColor
												arg.TrailColors = { ColorSequence.new(arg.TrailColor), colorSequence(fastTrailColor2) }
											end

											for k, v89 in arg.Trails, nil, nil do
												if enabled2 ~= arg.TrailMoving or trailFast ~= arg.TrailFast or flag19 then
													local v90 = arg.TrailColors[trailFast and 2 or v83[184]]
													v89.Enabled = enabled2
													v89.Color = v90
												end

												if v89.Lifetime ~= gamingChair.TrailLifetime then
													v89.Lifetime = gamingChair.TrailLifetime
												end

												if flag18 then
													v89.Attachment0.Position = tbl56[k] * scale
													v89.Attachment1.Position = (tbl56[k] + Vector3.new(v83[140], 0, 0.18)) * scale
												end

												if not gamingChair.Trails and arg.TrailsEnabled or flag18 or arg.LastPosition and (position - arg.LastPosition).Magnitude > 20 then
													v89:Clear()
												end
											end

											arg.TrailMoving = enabled2
											arg.TrailFast = trailFast
											arg.LastPosition = position
											arg.AppliedScale = scale
											arg.TrailsEnabled = gamingChair.Trails

											if arg.NextAnimation <= now2 then
												arg.NextAnimation = now2 + 0.25
												arg:UpdateAnimation()
											end
										end
									end
								end

								do
									do
										do
											tbl51.Refresh = function(arg)
												if arg.Unloaded or not getgenv().Elisium.Character.GamingChair.Enabled then
													arg.MeshLoadAttempted = false

													if arg.Bound then
														runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ElisiumGamingChair")

														arg:Update(arg2)
													end)

													arg.Bound = v83[160]
												end

												arg.NextAnimation = 0
												arg:Update(0)
											end

													EnsureFolder = function(arg, arg2)
														if not isfolder or not makefolder then
															return false
														end
														local ok, result = pcall(isfolder, arg2)
														if not ok then
															return false
														end

														if not result then
															ok = pcall(makefolder, arg2)
														end

														return ok and isfolder(arg2)
													end,
													MigrateLegacySkyboxes = function(arg)
														if not listfiles or not isfolder or not isfile or not readfile or not writefile then
															return
														end
														local ok, result = pcall(isfolder, str9)
														if not ok or not result then
															return
														end
														local ok2, result2 = pcall(listfiles, str9)
														if not ok2 or type(result2) ~= "table" then
															return
														end

														for _, v89 in result2, nil, nil do
															local ok3, result3 = pcall(isfolder, v89)

															if not (not ok3 or not result3) then
																local v90 = string.match(v89, "([^/\\]+)[/\\]*$")

																if v90 then
																	local str10 = str8 .. "/" .. v90

																	if arg:EnsureFolder(str10) then
																		for _, v91 in tbl55, nil, nil do
																			local str11 = v89 .. "/" .. v91
																			local str12 = str10 .. "/" .. v91
																			local ok4, result4 = pcall(isfile, str11)
																			local ok5, result5 = pcall(isfile, str12)

																			if ok4 and result4 and (not ok5 or not result5) then
																				local ok6, result6 = pcall(readfile, str11)

																				if ok6 and type(result6) == "string" then
																					pcall(writefile, str12, result6)
																				end
																			end
																		end
																	end
																end
															end
														end
													end,
													BuildElements = function(arg)
														table.clear(arg.elements)

														for k in arg.list, nil, nil do
															table.insert(arg.elements, k)
														end

														table.sort(arg.elements, function(arg2, arg3)
															return string.lower(arg2) < string.lower(arg3)
														end)
													end,
													Refresh = function(arg)
														table.clear(arg.list)
														table.clear(arg.local_assets)

														for k, v89 in arg.builtin_list, nil, nil do
															arg.list[k] = v89
														end

														if arg:EnsureFolder(str8) then
															arg:MigrateLegacySkyboxes()
															arg:LoadLocalSkyboxes()
														end

														arg:BuildElements()
														return arg.elements
													end,
													LoadLocalSkyboxes = function(arg)
														if not listfiles or not isfolder or not isfile or not getcustomasset then
															return
														end
														local ok, result = pcall(isfolder, str8)
														if not ok or not result then
															return
														end
														local ok2, result2 = pcall(listfiles, str8)
														if not ok2 or type(result2) ~= "table" then
															return
														end
														local tbl56 = {}

														for _, v89 in result2, nil, nil do
															local ok3, result3 = pcall(isfolder, v89)

															if ok3 and result3 then
																tbl56[v89] = true
															else
																local ok4, result4 = pcall(isfile, v89)

																if ok4 and result4 then
																	local v90 = string.match(v89, "^(.*)[/\\][^/\\]+$")

																	if v90 then
																		tbl56[v90] = v83[160]
																	end
																end
															end
														end

														for k in tbl56, nil, nil do
															local v89 = string.match(k, "([^/\\]+)[/\\]*$")

															if v89 then
																local tbl57 = { Local = true }
																local flag18 = true

																for k2, v90 in tbl55, nil, nil do
																	local str10 = k .. "/" .. v90
																	local ok3, result3 = pcall(isfile, str10)

																	if not ok3 or not result3 then
																		flag18 = false
																		break
																	else
																		tbl57[k2] = str10
																	end
																end

																if flag18 then
																	arg.list[v89] = tbl57
																end
															end
														end
													end,
													Resolve = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
														if not arg3.Local then
															return arg3
														end

														if arg.local_assets[arg2] then
															return arg.local_assets[arg2]
														end
														local tbl56 = {}

														for k in tbl55, nil, nil do
															local ok, result = pcall(getcustomasset, arg3[k])
															if not ok or type(result) ~= "string" or result == "" then
																return nil
															end
															tbl56[k] = result
														end

														arg.local_assets[arg2] = tbl56
														return tbl56
													end,
													RestoreDefault = function(arg)
														local sky = lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
														if not sky then
															return
														end

														for k, v89 in arg.default_skybox_properties, nil, nil do
															pcall(function()
																sky[k] = v89
															end)
														end

														arg.enforcing = false
														arg.active_name = nil
														arg.active_data = nil

														if arg.CreatedSky then
															arg.CreatedSky:Destroy()
															arg.CreatedSky = nil
														end
													end,
													ApplySelection = function(arg)
														local skybox = getgenv().Elisium.World.Skybox
														local selected = skybox.Selected
														if arg.Unloaded or not skybox.Enabled then
															return
														end
														local v89 = arg.list[selected]
														if not v89 then
															return
														end
														local v90 = arg:Resolve(selected, v89)
														if arg.Unloaded or not skybox.Enabled or skybox.Selected ~= selected then
															return
														end

														if not v90 then
															warn("Skybox could not be loaded: " .. tostring(selected))
															return
														end
														local sky = lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")

														if not sky then
															sky = Instance.new("Sky")
															sky.Parent = lighting
															arg.CreatedSky = sky
														end

														local activeData = {}

														for k, v91 in arg.default_skybox_properties, nil, nil do
															local v92 = v90[k]
															v91 = v92 == nil and v91
															activeData[k] = v91 or v92
														end

														local v91 = v83[160]
														arg.active_name = selected
														arg.active_data = activeData
														arg.enforcing = v91

														for k, v92 in activeData, nil, nil do
															sky[k] = v92
														end
													end,
													UpdateSkybox = function(arg)
														if arg.Unloaded then
															return
														end

														if not getgenv().Elisium.World.Skybox.Enabled then
															arg:RestoreDefault()
															return
														end
														arg.Pending = true

														if arg.Wake then
															arg.Wake:Fire()
														end
													end,
													StartWorker = function(arg)
														arg.Pending = true
														arg.Wake = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
														v85:Add(arg.Wake)

														v85:Add(task.spawn(function()
															while not arg.Unloaded do
																if arg.Pending then
																	arg.Pending = false
																	arg:ApplySelection()
																end

																if not arg.Pending then
																	arg.Wake.Event:Wait()
																end
															end
														end))
													end,
												}
											end
										end

										v85:Add(function()
											tbl52.Unloaded = true
											tbl52:RestoreDefault()
										end)

										atmosphereChanger = {}
										getgenv().AtmosphereChanger = atmosphereChanger

										atmosphereChanger.Init = function(arg)
											arg.default_properties = {}
											arg.enforcing = false
											arg.last_atmosphere = nil
											local atmosphere = lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")

											if atmosphere then
												arg.default_properties.Density = atmosphere.Density
												arg.default_properties.Offset = atmosphere.Offset
												arg.default_properties.Glare = atmosphere.Glare
												arg.default_properties.Haze = atmosphere.Haze
												arg.default_properties.Color = atmosphere.Color
												arg.default_properties.Decay = atmosphere.Decay
												arg.last_atmosphere = atmosphere
											end

											arg.properties_list = { "Glare", "Haze", "Offset", "Density" }
										end

										atmosphereChanger.UpdateAtmosphere = function(arg)
											if not getgenv().Elisium.World.Atmosphere.Enabled then
												arg.enforcing = v83[154]

												if arg.created_atmosphere then
													pcall(function()
														arg.created_atmosphere:Destroy()
													end)

													arg.created_atmosphere = nil
												end

												return
											end

											local atmosphere = lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")

											if not atmosphere then
												atmosphere = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
												atmosphere.Name = "ElisiumAtmosphere"
												atmosphere.Parent = lighting
												arg.created_atmosphere = atmosphere
											end

											local atmosphere2 = getgenv().Elisium.World.Atmosphere

											pcall(function()
												atmosphere.Density = atmosphere2.Density
												atmosphere.Offset = atmosphere2.Offset
												atmosphere.Glare = atmosphere2.Glare
												atmosphere.Haze = atmosphere2.Haze
												atmosphere.Color = atmosphere2.Color
												atmosphere.Decay = atmosphere2.Decay
											end)

											arg.enforcing = v83[160]
											arg.last_atmosphere = atmosphere
										end

										atmosphereChanger:Init()

										v85:Add(function()
											atmosphereChanger:UpdateAtmosphere()
										end)

										v85:Connect(runService.Heartbeat, function()
											if getgenv().Elisium.World.Skybox.Enabled and tbl52.enforcing and tbl52.active_data then

												if sky and tbl52.active_name == getgenv().Elisium.World.Skybox.Selected then

																sky[k] = v89
															end)
														end
													end
												end
											end

											if getgenv().Elisium.World.Atmosphere.Enabled and atmosphereChanger.enforcing then
												local atmosphere = lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
												local atmosphere2 = getgenv().Elisium.World.Atmosphere
												local flag18 = not atmosphere
												local flag19

													flag19 = flag18

												end

												if flag19 then
													if not atmosphere then
														atmosphere = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
														atmosphere.Name = "ElisiumAtmosphere"

														end

															local v98 = table.create(4, "")

																flag19 = type(arg2.Items) ~= v99
															end

																return v98
															end

															for _, v99 in arg2.Items, nil, nil do

																if type(v99.Get) == "function" then

																	result = ok and result or nil
																end

																if not num and v99.Info and v99.Info.Class then
																	num = tbl19[string.lower(tostring(v99.Info.Class))]
																end

														targetHUD.GetTarget = function(arg, arg2)
															local sources = arg2.Sources
															local targetHUDTargets = genv.TargetHUDTargets
															local enabled = arg:IsSourceSelected(sources, "ragebot") and getgenv().Elisium.Combat.Ragebot.Enabled and arg:IsValidTarget(ragebot.currentTargetPlayer)
															local currentTargetPlayer = nil

															if enabled then
																currentTargetPlayer = ragebot.currentTargetPlayer
															end

															if not currentTargetPlayer and arg:IsSourceSelected(sources, "silent aim") and getgenv().Elisium.Combat.SilentAim.Enabled then
																if targetHUDTargets then
																	currentTargetPlayer = os.clock() <= (targetHUDTargets.SilentAimExpiresAt or 0)
																else
																	currentTargetPlayer = targetHUDTargets
																end

																currentTargetPlayer = currentTargetPlayer and arg:IsValidTarget(targetHUDTargets.SilentAim) and targetHUDTargets.SilentAim or arg:GetClosestPlayer(tbl36:Get())
															end

															if not currentTargetPlayer and arg:IsSourceSelected(sources, "aimbot") and getgenv().Elisium.Combat.Aimbot.Enabled then
																currentTargetPlayer = targetHUDTargets and arg:IsValidTarget(targetHUDTargets.Aimbot) and targetHUDTargets.Aimbot or arg:GetClosestPlayer(getgenv().Elisium.Combat.Aimbot)
															end

															local now2 = os.clock()

															if arg:IsValidTarget(currentTargetPlayer) then
																arg.LastTarget = currentTargetPlayer
																arg.LastSeenAt = now2
																return currentTargetPlayer
															end

															if now2 - arg.LastSeenAt <= 0.35 and arg:IsValidTarget(arg.LastTarget) then
																return arg.LastTarget
															end
															arg.LastTarget = nil
															return nil
														end

																		tbl58[v91.cdn_url] = tbl59
																		tbl57[#tbl57 + v83[184]] = tbl59
																	end
																end

																end

																	Name = (match == "ttf" or match == "otf") and "Font" or v91.name,
																	Ids = tbl60,
																	Value = str8,
																	Property = v91.Property,
																}

																if tbl59 then
																	tbl59.Targets[#tbl59.Targets + v83[184]] = arg2.Rules[#arg2.Rules]
																end
															end
														end
													end
												end
											end

											fn35(arg3.replacement_rules)
											local n = 1
											local n35 = math.min(4, #tbl57)
											local v91 = nil

											for i = 1, n35 do
												task.spawn(function()
													local ok, result = pcall(function()
														while n <= #tbl57 and not v91 and arg2.Enabled and not arg2.Unloaded do
															local v92 = tbl57[n]
															n += 1
															local ok, value = pcall(v92.Run)
															local flag19 = not ok

															if flag19 and not arg3.AllowPartial then
																error(value, v83[140])
															end

															for _, v93 in v92.Targets, nil, nil do
																v93.Disabled = not ok

																if ok then
																	v93.Value = value
																end
															end

															if flag19 then
																warn("Elisium texture pack asset skipped: " .. tostring(value))
															end
														end
													end)

													if not ok then
														v91 = result
													end

													n35 -= 1
												end)
											end

											while n35 > 0 do
												task.wait()
											end

											if v91 then
												error(v91, v83[140])
											end

											assert(arg2.Enabled and not arg2.Unloaded, "texture loading cancelled")
										end

										tbl56.Apply = function(arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
											if not arg2.Enabled or not arg2.Records[arg3] or arg2.Records[arg3].MeshWriting then
												return
											end
											local v90 = arg3[arg4]
											if arg5.Applied ~= nil and v90 == arg5.Applied then
												return
											end
											arg5.Original = v90
											arg5.Applied = nil

											if arg4 == "LocalTransparencyModifier" then
												arg5.Applied = 1
												arg3[arg4] = 1
												return
											end

											local v91 = fn33(arg4 == "FontFace" and v90.Family or v90)
											if not v91 then
												return
											end
											local genv2 = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()
											if arg3:IsA("Sky") and genv2 and genv2.Elisium and genv2.Elisium.World.Skybox.Enabled then
												return
											end

											for _, v92 in arg2.Rules, nil, nil do
												local flag18 = v92.Name == v83[96] and arg4 == "FontFace" or v92.Name:sub(1, 3) == "Sky" and arg4 == "Skybox" .. v92.Name:sub(4) or v92.Name ~= "Font" and v92.Name:sub(1, 3) ~= "Sky" and arg4 ~= "FontFace"

												if not v92.Disabled and flag18 and (not v92.Property or v92.Property == arg4) and v92.Ids[v91] then
													arg5.Applied = v92.Value
													arg3[arg4] = v92.Value
													return
												end
											end
										end

										tbl56.Remove = function(arg2, arg3)
											local v90 = arg2.Records[arg3]
											if not v90 then
												return
											end
											arg2.Records[arg3] = nil

											if v90.Chunks then
												arg2.ChunkRecords[arg3] = nil

												if not next(arg2.ChunkRecords) and arg2.ChunkConnection then
													arg2.ChunkConnection:Disconnect()
													arg2.ChunkConnection = nil
												end

												for _, v91 in v90.Chunks, nil, nil do
													arg2.Generated[v91] = nil
													v91:Destroy()
												end
											end

											for _, v91 in v90.Connections, nil, nil do
												v91:Disconnect()
											end

											if v90.MeshOriginal then
												pcall(function()
													if not v90.MeshApplied or arg3.MeshContent == v90.MeshApplied then
														local textureID = arg3.TextureID
														arg3:ApplyMesh(v90.MeshOriginal)
														arg3.TextureID = textureID
													end
												end)

												v90.MeshOriginal:Destroy()
											end

											for k, v91 in v90.Properties, nil, nil do
												if v91.Applied ~= nil then
													pcall(function()
														if arg3[k] == v91.Applied then
															arg3[k] = v91.Original
														end
													end)
												end
											end
										end

										tbl56.Track = function(arg2, arg3)
											if not arg2.Enabled or arg2.Records[arg3] or arg2.Generated[arg3] then
												return
											end
											local tbl57

											if arg3:IsA("Sky") then
												tbl57 = { "SkyboxBk", "SkyboxDn", "SkyboxFt", "SkyboxLf", "SkyboxRt", "SkyboxUp" }
											elseif arg3:IsA("Sound") then
												tbl57 = { "SoundId" }
											elseif arg3:IsA("Animation") then
												tbl57 = { "AnimationId" }
											elseif arg3:IsA("TextLabel") or arg3:IsA("TextButton") or arg3:IsA("TextBox") then
												tbl57 = { "FontFace" }
											elseif arg3:IsA("ImageLabel") or arg3:IsA("ImageButton") then
												tbl57 = { v83[129] }
											elseif arg3:IsA("Decal") or arg3:IsA("Texture") or arg3:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or arg3:IsA(v83[37]) or arg3:IsA("Trail") then
												tbl57 = { "Texture" }
											elseif arg3:IsA("MeshPart") then
												tbl57 = { "TextureID" }
											elseif arg3:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
												tbl57 = { "TextureId" }

												if arg2.HideMeshes[fn33(arg3.MeshId)] and arg3.Parent then
													arg2:Track(arg3.Parent)
												end
											else
												if not arg3:IsA("BasePart") then
													return
												end
												local specialMesh = arg3:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
												if not (specialMesh and arg2.HideMeshes[fn33(specialMesh.MeshId)]) then
													return
												end
												tbl57 = { "LocalTransparencyModifier" }
											end

											if arg3:IsA("MeshPart") and arg2.HideMeshes[fn33(arg3.MeshId)] then
												tbl57[#tbl57 + 1] = "LocalTransparencyModifier"
											end

											local tbl58 = { Properties = {}, Connections = {} }
											arg2.Records[arg3] = tbl58

											for _, v90 in tbl57, nil, nil do
												local tbl59 = {}
												tbl58.Properties[v90] = tbl59

												tbl58.Connections[#tbl58.Connections + v83[184]] = arg3:GetPropertyChangedSignal(v90):Connect(function()
													arg2:Apply(arg3, v90, tbl59)
												end)

												arg2:Apply(arg3, v90, tbl59)
											end

											if arg3:IsA("MeshPart") then
												arg2:QueueMesh(arg3, tbl58)
											end
										end

										tbl56.Stop = function(arg2)
											if arg2.ChunkConnection then
												arg2.ChunkConnection:Disconnect()
												arg2.ChunkConnection = nil
											end

											for _, v90 in arg2.Connections, nil, nil do
												v90:Disconnect()
											end

											table.clear(arg2.Connections)

											for k in arg2.Records, nil, nil do
												arg2:Remove(k)
											end

											table.clear(arg2.MeshQueue)

											for _, v90 in arg2.MeshCache, nil, nil do
												if v90 then
													if v90.Chunks then
														for _, v91 in v90.Chunks, nil, nil do
															v91.Template:Destroy()
															v91.Editable:Destroy()
														end
													else
														v90.Template:Destroy()

														if v90.Editable then
															v90.Editable:Destroy()
														end
													end
												end
											end

											table.clear(arg2.MeshCache)
										end

										tbl56.Start = function(arg2)
											if not arg2.Enabled or arg2.Unloaded then
												return
											end
											arg2:Stop()

											arg2.Connections[v83[184]] = game.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
												arg2:Track(descendant)
											end)

												arg2:Remove(descendant)
											end)

											for k, v90 in game:GetDescendants() do
												if k % 250 == 0 then
													task.wait()
												end

												if not arg2.Enabled or arg2.Unloaded then
													return
												end

												if v90:IsDescendantOf(game) then
													arg2:Track(v90)
												end
											end
										end

										tbl56.SetEnabled = function(arg2, enabled)
											if arg2.Unloaded or arg2.Enabled == enabled then
												return
											end
											arg2.Enabled = enabled
											if not enabled then
												arg2:Stop()
												return
											end

											if arg2.Loading then
												return
											end
											arg2.Loading = true

												local ok, result = pcall(function()
													if not arg2.Ready then
														table.clear(arg2.Rules)
														arg2:Prepare(v89)
														arg2.Ready = true
													end

													arg2:Start()
												end)

												arg2.Loading = v83[154]

												if not ok then
													arg2.Enabled = false
													arg2:Stop()
													warn("Elisium texture pack: " .. tostring(result))
												end
											end)
										end

										tbl56.Unload = function(arg2)
											arg2.Unloaded = true
											arg2.Enabled = false
											arg2:Stop()
										end

										return tbl56
									end
